0022600217.text: The Wizards (4-6, 9th in the East, 2-4 on the road, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Pacers (3-7, 11th in the East, 0-5 at home, on a one-game losing streak) in Indiana for Washington's 12th game of the season. Washington sits 2.5 games back in the Southeast and Indiana 3.5 back in the Central, and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Wizards won their 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on February 20, 2026. Washington is missing Bilal Coulibaly (hand), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain).
